name: Ragon-Builds-Ragon benchmark
unit: price-weighted tokens (generated tokens only for method_version 0)

0.ragon_tokens: the node's model-server generation counter; generated tokens only; interactive use and QA smoke included
0.other_tokens: the coordinator's usage ledger, output tokens; a lower bound

1.ragon_tokens: the model gate's per-request usage counters, by job tag; generated, input and cache-read tokens at the published weights; reasoning tokens included
1.other_tokens: the coordinator's per-job usage ledger; the same three kinds, reasoning tokens included where reported
1.exclusions: benchmark nights, the morning QA, Night Shift tasks of the product, requests without a job tag
1.retry_rule: one retry, then fallback; every attempt's tokens count

points.notes: Partial week (2026-11-09 to 2026-11-12 09:40 UTC), hand-measured. ragon_generated_tokens: the node's model-server counter generation_tokens_total on the development node, 86 requests, counter window from the server's last restart at 2026-11-10 14:24 UTC; interactive use, the local helpers and QA smoke included; benchmark nights run on other nodes and are excluded. other_generated_tokens: the coordinator's usage ledger, output tokens, 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-12: coordinator 0.59 + 0.22 + 0.07 M, tracked agents 0.10 M; worker accounts are not yet in the ledger, so this is a lower bound and the share an upper bound.
